body: This is related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1753 but doesn't implement that proposal fully.

I've parked additional implementation for the fallback code here: https://github.com/BastiaanOlij/godot/tree/add_clip_distance_support_with_fallback
Specifically commit https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/45de00a37dfd9c2041a4e62d0244c49c680fdb0a

This has code for Vulkan to detect whether clipDistance and/or cullDistance are supported. I have not (yet) added similar code for DirectX nor Metal, but I have verified that clipDistance and cullDistance work as advertised on DirectX.

The main problem I ran into is that in order to do this work properly, we should be compiling a variant of the shaders that is aware of the maximum slots available to us on the hardware we're running on. With the current requirements around the shader baker specifically, including such platform dependent code is a no-go. I could maybe work around this with specialization constants, not sure.

The secondary problem is that the fallback requires the addition of our own variant. To make sure we support this fully, this needs to be a `float[6]` and it turns out this takes up a full 6 location slots **regardless** of whether we're using the fallback. This is an issue on our side with the way we determine the first available location slot for varying variables in our user shader.

RN this PR does what we need it to do for our project, so I'm parking the fallback code and support for the other 2 renderers for later when I have more time to work on this.
